answers.gold_br_shares_event_and_robots_with_tra: yes: same event (IRONCup 2025, ThundeRatz channel), same camera style, and the same pair of robots. gold_zb01 is Galena vs Gyarados (semifinal); train rounds tr_B_r1 and tr_fz_r1 are Galena vs Gyarados too (another match and the grand final), and Galena is in every BR train and val round. The gold BR is a held-out round, not a held-out event or robot.
answers.gold_jp_same_video_as_train_jp: yes: gold_jp25 (378.6-384.2 s) is a later round of Z_MC3r_c2P0.mp4, the same continuous fixed-camera video as the 8 JP train rounds, the JP val round and the 15 candidates_jp rounds.
answers.crop_gain_0.71_to_0.99_measured_on: gold BR only (gold_zb01, 59 frames). Before: a detector trained and evaluated on full frames (data/annotations/gold, native 1920x1080), from git history (diario 14, commit e7e1cd4: 'O recorte levou recall 0.91->0.98 e precisao 0.71->0.98'); no weights, run directory or JSON of that full-frame model survive in results/. After: the current crop-trained YOLOv8s on gold_crop (val P 0.990, R 0.964, reproduced in detection/detector_eval.json). The paper sentence therefore compares two different models on the same BR round, and the 'before' number is not reproducible from saved artifacts.
